findings.current: Do you people share a *Hundred Questions and Answers for Dealing with Jintaekyung* or something?
findings.defect: Jin Taekyung’s established name is incorrectly run together.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary establishes 진태경 as Jin Taekyung.
findings.replacement: Do you people share a *Hundred Questions and Answers for Dealing with Jin Taekyung* or something?
findings.source: 진태경 대응 백문백답 같은 거 공유하냐?

findings.current: They say the unexpected can catch you off guard.
findings.defect: The generic statement about surprise loses the idiom’s point that something dismissed as impossible can turn out to be true.
findings.rationale: The line directly follows Taekyung insisting that it could not be Asmodeus and marks that supposedly impossible possibility coming true.

findings.current: Yeah, I get it. He’s extremely high-ranking. Now answer me.
findings.defect: The translation replaces Taekyung’s profane 존귀/존나 귀여운 wordplay with a literal explanation of rank, losing both the joke and his register.
findings.rationale: Taekyung deliberately twists 존귀하신, “exalted,” into 존나 귀여운, “fucking adorable.”
findings.replacement: Yeah, yeah, I get it—he’s fucking adorable. Now answer me.
findings.source: 그래, 존나 귀여운 거 충분히 알겠으니까 대답해 봐.

findings.current: What, is the Demon King a child in a new country?
findings.defect: The literal rendering is unintelligible in English and loses the joke about an exceptionally well-behaved child following a prescribed bedtime routine.
findings.rationale: 새 나라의 어린이 invokes the Korean image of a model child who follows wholesome routines, which the following television, toothbrushing, and bedtime list elaborates.
findings.replacement: What is the Demon King, some good little schoolboy?

findings.current: No, I asked how much it pays. Don’t tell me you people expect free labor, too?
findings.defect: The draft makes the euphemistic labor joke explicit as unpaid work, losing the sarcastic phrase 열정 페이, literally compensation in passion.
findings.rationale: The source jokes about exploitative employers disguising poor or nonexistent compensation as work done for passion rather than stating “free labor” outright.
findings.replacement: No, I asked how much it pays. Don’t tell me you people pay in passion, too?
findings.source: 아니, 연봉 얼마 주냐고. 설마 너네도 열정 페이야?

findings.current: If my mom hadn’t stopped me, I nearly became the first martyr in that church’s history.
findings.defect: The subject is reversed: Taekyung was about to attack the deacon, so the deacon—not Taekyung—would have become the church’s first martyr.
findings.rationale: 엄마 안 말렸으면 implies Taekyung’s mother stopped him from acting against the previously mentioned deacon; the martyr is the deacon who would have died.
findings.replacement: If my mom hadn’t stopped me, he would’ve become the first martyr in that church’s history.
findings.source: 그때 엄마 안 말렸으면 그 교회 최초의 순교자 될 뻔했잖아.

findings.current:
The four words that emerged in a voice deeper and more sinister than anything else were not an answer to my question.

They were a curse that called for death.
findings.defect: The draft changes 네 글자 into four words, although the incantation 다크 핸드 consists of four Korean syllabic characters and only two English words.
findings.rationale: 네 글자 counts the four Korean syllabic units in 다크 핸드; calling “Dark Hand” four words creates an obvious quantity error.
findings.replacement:
The four-syllable incantation, uttered in a voice deeper and more sinister than ever, was not an answer to my question.

It was a curse that called forth death.
findings.source: 더없이 깊고 음산한 목소리로 이루어진 네 글자는, 질문에 대한 대답이 아닌 죽음을 부르는 저주였다.

findings.current:
> **System**
>
> - You have been afflicted with the **Status** abnormality **[Curse]**!
> - Due to **[Curse]**, all abilities related to the body have been temporarily reduced!
> - **[Strength]** has temporarily decreased by 20!
> - **[Stamina]** has temporarily decreased by 20!
> - **[Agility]**…
findings.defect: The System terms are incorrectly retained inside square brackets, and “Status abnormality” is an unnatural decomposition of 상태이상 rather than the established game term “status effect.”
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rules prohibit square brackets around System notices and UI terms; 신체에 관련된 모든 능력치 naturally means all physical attributes.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
>
> - You have been afflicted with the status effect **Curse**!
> - Due to **Curse**, all physical attributes have been temporarily reduced!
> - **Strength** has temporarily decreased by 20!
> - **Stamina** has temporarily decreased by 20!
> - **Agility**…
findings.source:
- 상태이상, [저주]에 걸렸습니다!

- [저주]로 인하여 신체에 관련된 모든 능력치가 일시적으로 하락합니다!

- [근력]이 일시적으로 20 하락했습니다!

- [체력]이 일시적으로 20 하락했습니다!

- [민첩]이…….

findings.current: A thorny vine several meters in diameter was cut apart in a single blow.
findings.defect: The draft changes the vine’s circumference into its diameter, substantially altering its stated dimensions.
findings.rationale: 둘레 denotes circumference or distance around an object, not diameter.
findings.replacement: A thorny vine measuring several meters around was cut apart in a single blow.
findings.source: 수 미터의 둘레를 지닌 가시넝쿨이 단 일격에 잘렸다.

findings.current: My gaze swept across the enormous net formed by hundreds, thousands of Bone Spears, then slowly began to move.
findings.defect: The action is reversed: his already moving eyes slow down rather than beginning to move.
findings.rationale: 훑던 identifies an ongoing scan, while 천천히 느려진다 states that the movement decelerates as his new perception emerges.
findings.replacement: My eyes, sweeping over the enormous net formed by hundreds—thousands—of Bone Spears, gradually slowed.
findings.source: 수백, 수천 개의 본 스피어로 이루어진 거대한 그물을 훑던 눈동자가 천천히 느려진다.

findings.defect: Quotation marks turn the technique name into spoken dialogue, adding an action absent from the source.
findings.rationale: The Korean line has no dialogue marks; in this first-person passage it functions as an internal technique identification rather than something Taekyung says aloud.

summary: The draft contains several action and quantity changes, a reversed subject in the church anecdote, omitted wordplay and register, and noncompliant System formatting.
